text:
Leah: Quick sync
Planning a 30m community launch: RefKit "Hands-On Sprint" next Fri 10am PT. Deliverables: tiny tutorial repo, 3-min screencast, mini-benchmark CSV, landing page + gated form, and 2 email sequences. Need owners and a simple inbound routing plan.
Marco: For the perf narrative: baseline vs tuned (batching + KV prefix cache + int8 quant). We'll show p95, cost/1k tokens, and tokens/sec. Small reproducible script and CSV.
Sam: Repo should be minimal: README, examples/{chat,summary,embed}, bench/run.sh, Dockerfile. Screencast = 3m show clone->run->enable cache. I'll own repo + screencast.
Priya: HubSpot form: fields email,name,role,company_size(dropdown: solo/startup/growth/enterprise). Hidden fields: lead_source=hands-on-sprint-2026, utm_campaign=hands-on-sprint. Map enterprise -> AE-inbound; else -> community-nurture. Who wants to draft the exact dropdown labels?
Leah: Priya take form + automations. Marco do bench and attach CSV. Sam do repo & screencast. I'll draft blog + social and coordinate design for hero/thumb.
Marco: Benchmark commands to include in README:
```bash
# baseline
bash bench/run.sh --model=mini --batch=1 --quant=none --iters=120
# tuned
bash bench/run.sh --model=mini --batch=8 --quant=int8 --kv_cache=on --iters=120
```
I'll export p95 and $/1k tokens to bench/results.csv.
Sam: I'll add a tiny CONTRIBUTING.md and a one-line run command for the Dockerfile so attendees can be up in <5m.
Priya: Routing specifics: registrants -> tag hands_on_sprint_2026. If company_size==enterprise -> ownerRotation=ae-team and add to #ae-inbound Slack. Non-enterprise -> add to 3-email nurture over 10 days. If attendee downloads CSV -> tag engaged_bench.
Leah: Email subject options: "Hands-On: Build a RefKit refapp in 30m" OR "RefKit Sprint: Build, Benchmark, Optimize". We'll A/B test subject line on first 400 sends.
Sam: Social plan: community channels 48h and 1h reminders + Discord seeding. We'll share repo link in the reminder messages.
Marco: Suggest we record and produce a 90s highlight reel for on-demand and a 30s social cut. The CSV + notebook should be downloadable from the landing page.
Priya: HubSpot will publish and give canonical URL. I'll paste final URL + field mapping here when done. Also set utm_source=community, utm_medium=email for the primary send.
Leah: Add a short CTA code snippet in the email body, e.g.:
```python
from redwood import Client
print(Client().generate("summarize: 'short doc'"))
```
Easy to copy.
event-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Hands-On Sprint: RefKit" Fri 10:00 PT
Reminders set at 48h, 1h, and 10m.
Leah: Final checklist: repo & screencast (Sam), bench CSV + notebook (Marco), HS form + routing (Priya), blog + social copy (Leah), hero/thumb (design). Ping here when each is complete. :sparkles:
